WHAT: OrbStack is actively running a full local dev infrastructure, not just installed.
CONTAINERS: 35 total, running for 22+ hours when discovered.
WHISNAP K8S (kind cluster): whisnap-local-control-plane, postgres 15, redis 7, pgbouncer, prometheus, grafana, kind-registry + K8s system pods (CoreDNS, Traefik, local-path-provisioner, load balancers) + whisnap namespace with another postgres/redis/pgbouncer inside cluster.
VINTED FASHION FINDER (Docker Compose): vinted-fashion-finder-app (Node), vinted-fashion-finder-playwright (Playwright browser automation), vinted-fashion-finder-postgres (Postgres 17).
IMPACT: Was eating 81% CPU and killing battery.
PAUSE/RESUME: Safe to stop all containers via OrbStack UI or menu bar quit — data persists via volumes. K8s kind cluster 95% survives, occasionally needs `kind delete cluster && kind create cluster` if it gets confused.
